items.title: A Pre-registered, Cryptographically Timestamped Proving Protocol for Directional Market Forecasting, with Announced Echo State Network and Quantum Reservoir Computing Examinations
items.claim: Directional forecasting models underperform simple price-based forecasts even with careful pre-registration.

items.title: Does Empirical Finance Replicate?
items.claim: Published finance studies replicate in-sample but collapse out-of-sample, consistent with data snooping.

items.title: Point-in-Time SEC Financial Data: A Reproducible Benchmark for Detecting Look-Ahead and Restatement Leakage
items.claim: Financial data services leak look-ahead bias into historical backtests through retention rules.

items.title: A Thousand Agents, One Opinion: Effective Population Collapse in LLM-based Artificial Markets
items.claim: Aligned language-model agents exhibit high cross-correlation, reducing sixteen agents to 2.6 effective traders.

items.title: Reasoning More, Knowing No Better? Epistemic Calibration in Financial Reasoning Tasks
items.claim: Increased reasoning effort improves LLM accuracy on financial tasks without improving calibration.

items.title: When LLMs Whisper: Information Leakage and Collusion in Financial Markets
items.claim: LLM reasoning traces could enable tacit collusion by revealing rivals' intended orders.
